summary: Phase 2 (Admin / Vendor / Delivery panels) tested end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass covering /admin/stats (shape + math + role guard + 401), /admin/users (filter, password-stripped, toggle round-trip), /admin/orders (status filter + advance + customer notification), /admin/products CRUD (create→GET 200, update, delete→GET 404), /admin/categories + /admin/banners create/delete, /admin/commission get/set persist, /vendor/stats (stores st-1 + st-4 scoping verified, payout = revenue*(1-commission/100)), /vendor/products scoped to own stores only, /vendor/orders my_items + my_revenue math, vendor cannot edit foreign product (404), /delivery/online toggle + /delivery/me persistence, /delivery/available returns only status=accepted with no delivery_id, full claim→out_for_delivery→deliver flow with double-claim 400, /delivery/stats earnings = delivered*₹30, and 403 role guards for all panels. Frontend (web preview, 390x844 mobile viewport): admin@/vendor@/delivery@ all log in and route directly to /admin, /vendor, /delivery (not /role/*). Admin dashboard renders KPI cards (₹2974.45 revenue, ₹297.44 platform earnings @ 10%, 3 customers / 2 vendors / 1 delivery / 4 orders), 7-day chart bar (4 on Mon), pending-orders alert card, and Quick Actions grid; Customers shortcut routes to /admin/users?role=customer correctly. /admin/orders shows filter chips (All/Pending/Accepted/Out/Delivered) and per-order action buttons. /admin/commission save tap works (persisted via API; restored to 10% after run). Vendor dashboard shows orange gradient hero payout ₹712.8 (after 12% comm during run), KPI cards, Fresh Mart + Tasty Bites stores, Quick Actions; /vendor/earnings shows full breakdown card (Gross ₹810 − ₹97.20 = Net ₹712.8). Delivery dashboard shows online/offline toggle (green gradient), three-tab segmented control (Available / Active / History) — all tab switches work, History tab shows the order that was claimed+delivered during backend tests. 0 console errors captured across all panels. No red screens. Phase 1 customer flow unaffected (already validated in iteration_1).

issues: Action button label renders as 'Mark as OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' (raw enum with underscore). Suggest humanising to 'Mark as Out for Delivery' for consistency with 'Mark as ACCEPTED' (which is already ALL-CAPS but readable).

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated by RN Web — gradient/card components in admin/vendor/delivery panels likely still emit warnings. Reference: any new component using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius across /app/frontend/app/admin/*, /vendor/*, /delivery/*.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Humanise the 'Mark as OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' button label on /admin/orders to title case.
(Carry-over from Phase 1, optional) Migrate React Native shadow* style props to boxShadow on the new admin/vendor/delivery cards to silence RN-Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1114 lines with admin/vendor/delivery routes appended to a single file; before Phase 3 split into routers/admin.py, routers/vendor.py, routers/delivery.py for maintainability.

Several admin/vendor write endpoints return raw dicts after popping _id manually (e.g. admin_create_product / banner / category) instead of using Pydantic response_models. Consider response_model=ProductOut etc. to enforce schema and avoid future _id leaks.

/admin/orders/{id}/status accepts ANY string for status (OrderStatusIn uses bare str) — no enum validation. A typo like 'accpeted' would persist as the status and break filters. Use Literal['pending','accepted','out_for_delivery','delivered'] or an Enum.
delivery_claim does not require online=true on the delivery user; a delivery partner whose UI toggle is OFF can still claim via API. UI disables the button but backend should also guard.
vendor_accept allows ANY vendor to accept ANY order (not scoped to vendor's products). Vendor1 could accept an order containing only Vendor2's items. Add a scope check before transitioning status.
admin_create_product allows any store_id and any category_id without existence validation — could create orphaned products. Validate store_id and category_id exist.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase 2 panel smoke flows (admin, vendor, delivery dashboards + nav + key actions)

seed_data_creation: Test created and then deleted: 1 TEST_AdminProd product, 1 TEST_Cat category, 1 TEST_Banner banner. Commission was temporarily mutated (10→15→restored to original 10 inside test; UI test then set to 12 and was restored to 10 by post-test cleanup curl). One pre-seeded pending order was advanced to accepted by admin_update_order test (state change is real but acceptable per problem statement which said 2 orders already pre-accepted for delivery to claim). Two pre-accepted orders were claimed+delivered by delivery test — delivery History tab now shows the claim/deliver outcome (intended).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 panels fully validated. New testIDs: admin-dashboard, admin-logout, admin-action-{Label} (Customers/Vendors/All Orders/Products/Categories/Banners/Delivery Partners/Commission), pending-orders-shortcut, admin-commission-screen, commission-input, preset-{5|8|10|12|15|20}, save-commission, vendor-dashboard, vendor-logout, vendor-{Label}, delivery-dashboard, delivery-logout, online-toggle, tab-{available|active|history}, delivery-order-{id}, claim-{id}, deliver-{id}. Demo accounts post-test state: delivery has 1+ delivered order in history; commission restored to 10%. To re-create available pickups for delivery tests, admin must advance some pending orders to accepted via /api/admin/orders/{id}/status. JWT/role guards confirmed: customer→403 on /admin/*, /vendor/*, /delivery/*.
rca_of_issue: No bugs; all listed items are minor enhancements / hardening suggestions.
